name: Snellig's Snuffbox
summary: At the Lost Fleet, Snellig's Snuffbox remains with its undead owner among the wrecks. First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil Harbor wants it as proof his cursed crewmate has been put to rest.

sections.title: A Keepsake of the Third Fleet
sections.body: First Mate Snellig still clutches his snuffbox in a wreck off the northern Wetlands. When the Third Fleet of Kul Tiras ran aground there, its sailors and officers drowned beneath a mysterious power tied to a hidden treasure aboard the ships. Bound by that power, the drowned crew rose again as tortured spirits and skeletal undead. Snellig haunts the rotting hold of the wreck closest to the coastline. His snuffbox is a small, ordinary reminder of his mortal life at sea. First Mate Fitzsimmons, the disaster's sole living survivor, wants this possession returned as proof that at least one lost shipmate has found release from torment.

faq.answer: First Mate Snellig once owned the small, personal container called Snellig's Snuffbox. His undead remnant carries it aboard a shipwreck off the northern Wetlands coast.

faq.q: Where do I find Snellig's Snuffbox?
faq.answer: You can take the snuffbox from First Mate Snellig, who haunts the hold of the shipwreck closest to shore at the Lost Fleet in the northwestern Wetlands.

aliases: who do i turn this into
faq.answer: First Mate Fitzsimmons wants you to bring him the snuffbox at Menethil Harbor. The Third Fleet's sole living survivor asks for it as proof that Snellig has been put to rest.

faq.q: Why is First Mate Snellig cursed?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons says a dark, terrible treasure hidden aboard one of the Third Fleet's vessels doomed the crews when the ships wrecked. Their souls remain trapped in the rotting timbers, denied rest.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, recovering the possessions of fallen Kul Tiran sailors and laying their cursed spirits to rest is a grim duty to an old naval ally.
